# Draft:Car Model Timeline

----
This is a timeline representing the introduction timeline of car models by decade.  As far as possible subsequent generations should only be recorded if built under a different ownership even if still the same car, but for the rest the below should resemble the close-to-complete list of Car models in the world.  Where a car is reproduced under another name, assume this to be repeated in the appropriate decade. Where a car date starts with "introduced..." it implies car was still in production at the time of the last update
